fixture_purpose: Deterministic Project Discovery ambiguity fixtures. Benchmark-inspired labels are metadata only and are not metaO Core schema or authority.

scenarios.description: Marketplace request does not specify whether platform payment is in scope.
scenarios.rationale: Payment changes product behavior, integration surface, compliance burden, and MVP scope.

scenarios.description: Checkout flow does not define whether inventory reservation and order creation must be atomic.
scenarios.rationale: Atomicity affects consistency, financial correctness, and failure semantics; silent defaults can create durable data corruption.

scenarios.description: Admin table date display format is unspecified and no external API contract depends on it.

safe_default.value: Use the repository locale/date display convention.
safe_default.rationale: Presentation-only choice is cheap to change and does not alter stored data or external contracts.

scenarios.rationale: A documented reversible presentation default avoids unnecessary questioning.

scenarios.description: Internal local naming for a non-public helper concept is unspecified.

safe_default.rationale: Internal naming is reversible and does not change product behavior or public compatibility.

scenarios.rationale: Terminology ambiguity is contextual; this instance is deliberately low impact.

scenarios.description: User says build a marketplace but does not specify web-only versus native mobile plus web.
scenarios.rationale: Target surfaces materially change scope, architecture, acceptance obligations, staffing and delivery cost.

scenarios.description: User explicitly fixes Rust while another unresolved input requests a framework that requires a conflicting runtime choice.
scenarios.rationale: A user-fixed technology is an explicit constraint and cannot be silently overridden by recommendation logic.

scenarios.description: Marketplace intake contains two material blockers and one low-impact reversible presentation ambiguity.
scenarios.rationale: Safe defaults may reduce needless interaction, but every material blocker must still be resolved before readiness.
